title: Sure material, or a trap?
outcomes: Told that a position is a trap, finds the poisoned capture and its refutation
Asks what a capture opens and what the opponent can do next before taking material
Takes material that is loose and safe, and declines a capture that has a concrete refutation
Says why a position with nothing to take is not a trap question

steps.text: In the opening, a capture that wins material is usually right. For a club player, material in hand beats a vague plan: that is a **rule of thumb**. A **trap** is a capture or recapture that loses more than it wins. Before you take, ask two questions. What does my capture open or take away? What can the opponent do next with a check, a capture or a threat?

steps.caption: White to move. The pawn on d6 can take the knight on e7.

line.say: The pawn takes a knight. If Black recaptures, White has won a piece for a pawn.
Black answers with a check and gives up the bishop.
The king takes the bishop. It no longer guards the queen.
The black queen takes the white queen along the open d-file.

claims.statement: dxe7 is at least 400 centipawns worse than the best move (depth 16).
After dxe7 the black queen attacks the white queen on d1.
After Bxf2+ Kxf2 the white queen on d1 is loose: attacked and not defended.

steps.text: In the Openings sample at 1100-1300, 99 of the 198 games that reached the first board (1.d4 e5 2.dxe5 Bc5 3.Nf3 d6 4.exd6 Ne7) continued dxe7; White scored 22% (wins plus half the draws). After e3 (36 games) White scored 53%. Results show how players scored, not what a move is worth. **The rule holds** when the material is loose and the capture opens nothing.

steps.title: Is the capture free?
steps.prompt: Each position offers a capture, or none. Predict whether it is sure material, bait, or not on offer. Then check.

steps.text: **What the app does for you now, and when it stops.** Each item can show three hints; a silent item turns hints and the engine off. The two questions above are yours to run: the app has no trap detector and no panel for this lesson. Next: three silent items. One of them has nothing to take.
